# Scaffold New Web Page

Create a new, production-ready HTML page following the repository's semantic standards.

## Requirements

1. Standard HTML5 boilerplate (`<!DOCTYPE html>`, `<html lang="en">`, responsive viewport meta, charset UTF-8).
2. Include page `<title>` and descriptive meta tags.
3. Use semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main id="main-content">`, and `<footer>`.
4. Include a `.skip-link` for keyboard navigation: `<a href="#main-content" class="skip-link">Skip to main content</a>`.
5. Apply mobile-first CSS styles with responsive layout and WCAG 2.2 AA compliant contrast.
6. Link back to the home page / navigation hierarchy.
